client_2024-11-05.instructions: Use Cortex before Grep or raw file reads. Start with cortex_query for a coding task and cortex_context before multi-file edits. Search with cortex_search_symbols for named identifiers or cortex_search_text for body text and literals. Read indexed source with cortex_read_symbol or cortex_read_file. Check blast radius with cortex_impact and cortex_references, and run cortex_risk before finishing. Fall back to raw Grep or Read only when the index is missing or Cortex coverage is insufficient; call cortex_refresh for a missing or stale index.
